subject: Cornerstone: umbrella addendum to support staged capacity increases
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@cornerstone.io>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: michael.torres@cornerstone.io, legal@cornerstone.io
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Cornerstone umbrella addendum (initial redline)

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. Per our talk, attached is Cornerstone's initial redline to the umbrella addendum intended to sit alongside the new order form for the staged capacity increases we discussed (OrderForm_2027Q3_StagedRamp.xlsx). High level items to flag:

- We retained a 12-month minimum term and annual auto-renew. Need to confirm Redwood's comfort with that cadence.
- Liability: Cornerstone will request a higher cap than in the current MSA (we proposed $10M).
- Data retention/backup carveouts: asking that logs for billing & audit be kept for 5 years.
- SLA credits want a more prescriptive schedule tied to p50/p95 windows.

We attached a tracked copy (Cornerstone_Umbrella_Addendum_v1_redline.docx). If Redwood can provide a clean version with your preferred positions called out (particularly liability and term length), we can try to narrow quickly.

Attachments: Cornerstone_Umbrella_Addendum_v1_redline.docx; OrderForm_2027Q3_StagedRamp.xlsx

Thanks —
Patricia Gomez
Head of Procurement, Cornerstone Technologies
patricia.gomez@cornerstone.io

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@cornerstone.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cornerstone umbrella addendum (initial redline)

Patricia —

Appreciate the redline and the clear summary. Quick internal readout and suggested positions below — aim to get to a mutually acceptable draft by early next week.

Key positions Redwood will push for:
1) Term: agree to staged ramp but prefer a 24-month master rhythm with the addendum operating as a 12-month billing overlay (i.e., MSA term remains 24mo to avoid frequent renegotiation).
2) Liability: cannot accept a flat $10M cap. We propose either 3x 12-month committed fees or a fixed $5M cap, whichever is lower.
3) Data retention: we can provide billing/audit logs for 5 years but require scoped-purpose language and limited PII retention.
4) SLA credits: we'll accept a prescriptive table but need to limit aggregate credits to 50% of monthly fees per incident and 100% cap per quarter.

Laura is looping our legal team for markups — cc'd. Neha will run the order-form capacity ramp against Dedicated capacity to confirm feasibility. Karthis (karthik) will review procurement constraints for auto-renew triggers.

Can you confirm Cornerstone's flexibility on the liability proposal? If not, we should flag this for a short exec call.

Attachments: PRD-Umbrella-v2.docx (internal draft for discussion)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@cornerstone.io>, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cornerstone umbrella addendum (initial redline)

Patricia / team —

Thanks for the redline. We've taken a pass and attached our annotated response (PRD-Umbrella-v2.docx) with in-line comments. High-level legal notes below so we can converge efficiently:

- Term / Renewals: Redwood will accept a 12-month operational addendum cadence, but request MSA-level term remain 24 months and that addendum auto-renewals are conditional on mutual acceptance of an Exhibit A ramp schedule. This avoids surprise auto-increases.
- Liability / Cap: Redwood's preferred language: "Liability shall not exceed the lesser of (a) $5,000,000 or (b) three (3) times the annual fees paid in the prior twelve (12) months." Please review and let us know if Cornerstone needs a specific carveout for willful misconduct.
- Billing logs: we will provide billing/audit logs for five (5) years. Redwood requires a written request + limited discovery scope; PII not to be retained beyond operational needs.
- SLA credits: propose the attached table. Request Cornerstone confirms acceptance or proposes specific p95 thresholds.

One open commercial item: Cornerstone's ask for an immediate capacity guarantee in month one of the ramp. Neha — can you confirm we can commit a 30% reserved buffer for month 1 across Dedicated pools?

Patricia, if you can accept the liability phrasing above we can produce a clean addendum and an updated order form for signature.

Attachments: PRD-Umbrella-v2.docx (redlined reply), SLA-CreditTable.csv (internal)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@cornerstone.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@cornerstone.io>, legal@cornerstone.io
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cornerstone umbrella addendum (initial redline)

Laura / Priyom —

Appreciate the quick turn. A few points from our side after internal review:

- Term: Cornerstone prefers the addendum to be plainly 12 months with automatic renewal unless we provide 60 days' notice. We can be flexible on Exhibit A gating language, but we want predictable billing cadence.
- Liability: $5M + 3x fees is a meaningful movement from our original $10M request; our legal team asks for a narrow exception for data breaches caused by Redwood's gross negligence — effectively a carveout that would allow for higher recovery in those limited cases. Can you propose acceptable carveout language?
- Capacity guarantee: we cannot accept a 30% reserved buffer if it requires payment for unused reserved GPUs. Cornerstone expects Redwood to support a soft buffer for month 1 without additional committed charges; we are willing to include a ramp schedule with minimum guaranteed baseline.
- SLA: we'll accept the credit table in principle but need clearer escalation routes and a named Redwood contact for each severity.

Quote previous thread for context:
> On Fri, 30 Jul 2027 at 11:07 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Patricia / team —
> > Thanks for the redline. We've taken a pass...

We can discuss the liability carveout on a brief call — my head of security, Michael, and I are available Monday (Aug 2) morning PT.

Patricia
Head of Procurement, Cornerstone Technologies

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@cornerstone.io>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@cornerstone.io>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cornerstone umbrella addendum (initial redline)

Patricia / Michael —

Thanks for the constructive feedback and the call offer. To keep momentum and avoid escalation, proposed compromise below:

1) Term / renewal: Redwood will accept addendum-level 12-month automatic renewals with a 60-day opt-out, provided Exhibit A contains a mutually-agreed ramp and a quarterly review clause. MSA remains 24 months.

2) Liability carveout language (suggested): "Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party's liability for direct damages resulting from gross negligence or willful misconduct shall not be subject to the cap set forth above and shall be limited to proven direct damages only; consequential damages remain excluded. The parties will use reasonable good-faith efforts to mediate before pursuing such claims." Please confirm if this narrows Cornerstone's carveout requirement.

3) Capacity / buffer: Redwood agrees to a soft buffer for month 1 (no additional committed fees) up to 20% of the initial ramp. For guaranteed capacity beyond that, Redwood will reflect any additional reserved charge on the order form. Neha has flagged that Dedicated pools can support the 20% soft buffer for the planned ramp dates.

4) SLA + escalation: We'll add a one-page escalation annex with named contacts (SRE on-call, CS AM, and Legal ops). We'll include a DocuSign-ready order form with the Exhibit A ramp.

Next steps:
- If Cornerstone agrees to the liability phrasing above, Laura will produce a clean addendum + updated order form and send via DocuSign.
- Otherwise, happy to take the liability carveout to a 20-30 minute call on Mon 08/02 — please indicate preferred time.

Attachments: OrderForm_2027Q3_StagedRamp_v2.xlsx (updated schedule)
DocuSign link: https://na01.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=1111

Request: can Cornerstone return a counter-marked clean copy by EOD Friday 06 Aug so we can lock the Sept ramp?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
